commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Some patient build-up play from Osasuna as they look to unlock the defence.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

90' 0 - 3 Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) meets a perfect cross from Jailson deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:3.
87' Substitution. Luca de la Torre did his best and is replaced by Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo).
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kike Barja (Osasuna) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola Rojas didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

82' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) receives a neat pass inside the box with his back to goal, swivels and hits a powerful shot that goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
81' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
79' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) produced a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Sergio Herrera thwarted him with a fabulous save.
78' The Osasuna players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
75' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) replaces Raul Garcia.
75' Here is a change. Ruben Pena is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Kike Barja (Osasuna).
73' Substitution. Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) on for Javier Manquillo.
72' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
70' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' Osasuna are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
64' A cross from a corner kick by Osasuna is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
64' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.

63' What a miss! The corner finds Raul Garcia (Osasuna) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
63' Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
62' We are about to witness a subsitution. Johan Mojica (Osasuna) for Alejandro Catena.
62' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Pablo Ibanez and he is replaced by Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna).
62' The substitution is prepared. Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Moi Gomez.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch for Jorgen Strand Larsen.

61' Good team movement sets up Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
60' Osasuna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
58' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
55' Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
53' A spell of possession for Osasuna in an attempt to control the game.
51' Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul after Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

48' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
47' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the left post.
45+1' Rough tackle by Ruben Pena (Osasuna). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Celta Vigo are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
44' One of the Osasuna players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
41' Osasuna fail to score from a corner as Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo) leaps to collect the ball.
40' A player from Celta Vigo commits a rough challenge. Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
37' A player from Celta Vigo pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
36' Great teamplay by Celta Vigo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
33' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
32' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) is penalised for holding. Javier Alberola Rojas signals a set piece.
29' Some great controlled play and passing from Celta Vigo. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
25' 0 - 2 Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the middle of the net.
24' 0 - 1 Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
22' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
20' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Jailson (Celta Vigo). Javier Alberola Rojas saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
19' The Celta Vigo players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
16' Osasuna players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.

15' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Sergio Herrera, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
14' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
12' David Garcia (Osasuna) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
12' Osasuna hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
9' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

9' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Ante Budimir (Osasuna) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Vicente Guaita pulls off a brilliant save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Osasuna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.
3' A corner kick by Celta Vigo is thwarted by the well prepared Sergio Herrera (Osasuna).
2' Celta Vigo hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Osasuna will kick the game off.
Javier Alberola Rojas is the one to supervise the game today.
